question: A man has to travel a distance of 132 km in 14 hours. If he travels two-thirds of this distance in (3)/(7) of the total time, what should be his speed (in km/hr) to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 132 km, total time = 14 hr

2/3 distance = 88 km done in (3/7 × 14) = 6 hr

Remaining distance = 44 km, remaining time = 8 hr

Required speed = 44 ÷ 8

**∴ Answer = 5.5 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 132 km

Total time = 14 hours

Distance covered = 2/3 in 3/7 of total time

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered = (2/3) × 132 = 88 km

⇒ Time taken = (3/7) × 14 = 6 hours

⇒ Remaining distance = 132 − 88 = 44 km

⇒ Remaining time = 14 − 6 = 8 hours

⇒ Required speed = 44 ÷ 8

⇒ Required speed = 5.5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 5.5 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Fraction Concept

Part of quantity = Fraction × Total value

Remaining Quantity

Remaining = Total − Completed

Time Distribution

Split total time proportionally using given fractions
